summary: Unlock new opportunities in the insurance sector with our InsurTech training. Stay competitive by learning cutting-edge technology and industry best practices.
lede: InsurTech training covers how insurance professionals apply digital tools to underwriting, claims, and customer service. Designed for people familiar with insurance operations, it helps them assess readiness and plan practical workflow improvements across legacy systems and digital channels. Learners practice mapping underwriting and claims processes, evaluating data and technology needs, and defining governance controls for analytics, cybersecurity, and third-party risk.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for insurance professionals who already know the basics of policy, claims, and distribution work and now need to apply technology in a practical way.
modules: Insurance Technology landscape and operating model
Insurance distribution technology and customer experience
prerequisites: Bring an understanding of insurance workflows and a willingness to work with sample policy, claims, and distribution artefacts. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended for the diagnostic, dashboard, and roadmap exercises; no programming background is needed.
